2. Inspection Summary

On Friday, October 16, 2026, I visited the Cristo Rey Jesuit STEAM Building to review the blue mason scaffold towers in the stairwell and along the adjacent walls.

During the visit, I spoke with Antonio, the Foreman in charge of the project, and Jose, who is in charge of the finishers. Both asked me to return on Monday, October 19, 2026, to check whether the scaffold is ready to be brought down.

I will make that visit on Monday. If the scaffold is ready, I will bring it down the same day.

3. Safety Measures Verified
Cross Bracing in Place
Cross bracing is installed between the scaffold frames.
Platforms and Planking
Aluminum plank platforms are in place, and the wood planks are tied down with wire.
Guardrails and Access
Guardrail tubes are installed at the platforms, and ladder access is provided at the stairwell tower.
Danger Tape
Danger tape is placed across the stairs and on the scaffold.
Coordination with Foreman and Finishers
I reviewed the scaffold status with Antonio and Jose; I will return to check on Monday, October 19, 2026.
